Chocolate Almond Oatmeal
By: Homemade & Yummy
Published: Wednesday, April 20, 2016 - 3:31pm

Ingredients




3 cups unsweetened Almond Milk
1 cup Steel Cut Oats (quick cooking version)
1/4 cup Chia seeds
1/2 cup Goji berries (dried)
1/4 cup Cacao powder
1/4 cup Honey (raw, organic)
2 tbsp. Hemp hearts (for garnish)
Fresh berries (optional, for garnish)

Preparation

1 Measure and add all ingredients into a bowl 2 Mix until well combined 3 Cover and place in fridge overnight 4 When ready to eat, scoop into bowl, add fresh berries, sprinkle with hemp hearts 5 ENJOY!!

About

Chocolate Almond Oatmeal packed with superfood nutrition is a fast and easy breakfast/brunch meal.
